challenges.sol: SELECT numero_vol, date_depart, heure_depart FROM vols WHERE statut = 'Retardé' ORDER BY date_depart, heure_depart;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM passagers WHERE nationalite = 'Française' ORDER BY nom, prenom;
SELECT v.numero_vol, a.nom, a.ville FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id WHERE a.pays = 'Espagne' ORDER BY a.ville, v.numero_vol;
SELECT r.id, r.classe, r.prix, v.numero_vol FROM reservations r JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id ORDER BY r.prix DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT b.id, p.prenom, p.nom, v.numero_vol FROM bagages b JOIN reservations r ON r.id = b.reservation_id JOIN passagers p ON p.id = r.passager_id JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id WHERE b.statut = 'Perdu' ORDER BY b.id;
SELECT v.numero_vol, v.heure_depart, v.statut FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_depart_id WHERE a.ville = 'Paris' ORDER BY v.heure_depart, v.numero_vol;
SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, p.email FROM passagers p LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom;
SELECT v.numero_vol, v.date_depart, v.statut FROM vols v LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.date_depart, v.numero_vol;
SELECT id, statut, reservation_id FROM bagages WHERE poids_kg IS NULL ORDER BY id;

SELECT DISTINCT p.prenom, p.nom, v.numero_vol FROM reservations r JOIN passagers p ON p.id = r.passager_id JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id WHERE r.classe = 'Affaires' ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom, v.numero_vol;
SELECT modele, immatriculation, capacite FROM avions WHERE capacite > 200 ORDER BY capacite DESC;
SELECT prenom, nom, email FROM passagers WHERE email LIKE '%.de' ORDER BY nom;
SELECT numero_vol, heure_depart, statut FROM vols WHERE date_depart = '2025-06-13' ORDER BY heure_depart;
SELECT DISTINCT nationalite FROM passagers ORDER BY nationalite;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE classe = 'Affaires';
SELECT id, poids_kg FROM bagages ORDER BY poids_kg DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_naissance FROM passagers WHERE date_naissance < '1985-01-01' ORDER BY date_naissance;
SELECT nom, ville, pays FROM aeroports WHERE pays IN ('Espagne', 'Portugal') ORDER BY ville;
SELECT nom, pays, code FROM compagnies WHERE pays <> 'France' ORDER BY nom;
SELECT numero_vol, date_depart, heure_depart FROM vols WHERE heure_depart < '09:00' ORDER BY date_depart, heure_depart;
SELECT classe, ROUND(AVG(prix), 2) AS prix_moyen FROM reservations GROUP BY classe ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC;
SELECT nationalite, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM passagers GROUP BY nationalite ORDER BY nb DESC, nationalite;
SELECT SUM(poids_kg) FROM bagages;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT passager_id) FROM reservations;
SELECT numero_vol, date_depart, statut FROM vols WHERE statut = 'Retardé' OR statut = 'Annulé' ORDER BY numero_vol;
SELECT modele, immatriculation, capacite FROM avions WHERE modele NOT LIKE 'Airbus%' ORDER BY immatriculation;
SELECT prenom || ' ' || nom AS voyageur FROM passagers WHERE nationalite = 'Japonaise' ORDER BY nom;
SELECT prenom, nom, date_naissance FROM passagers WHERE strftime('%Y', date_naissance) = '1990' ORDER BY nom;
SELECT id, prix FROM reservations ORDER BY prix DESC LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1;
SELECT statut, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM vols GROUP BY statut ORDER BY nb DESC, statut;
SELECT nationalite, COUNT(*) AS nb FROM passagers GROUP BY nationalite HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY nb DESC, nationalite;
SELECT SUM(capacite) FROM avions;
SELECT statut, COUNT(*) AS nb_bagages FROM bagages GROUP BY statut ORDER BY nb_bagages DESC;

SELECT v.numero_vol, v.date_depart, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM vols v LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol, v.date_depart ORDER BY nb_reservations DESC, v.numero_vol;
SELECT c.nom, SUM(r.prix) AS chiffre_affaires FROM compagnies c JOIN vols v ON v.compagnie_id = c.id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY c.id, c.nom ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC;

SELECT a.ville, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations FROM vols v JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY a.id, a.ville ORDER BY nb_reservations DESC, a.ville LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.id, v.numero_vol, r.prix FROM reservations r JOIN vols v ON v.id = r.vol_id WHERE r.classe = 'Économique' AND r.prix > (SELECT AVG(prix) FROM reservations WHERE classe = 'Économique') ORDER BY r.prix DESC;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, COUNT(DISTINCT r.vol_id) AS nb_vols FROM passagers p JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.vol_id) >= 2 ORDER BY nb_vols DESC, p.nom;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom FROM passagers p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r WHERE r.passager_id = p.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservations r JOIN bagages b ON b.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.passager_id = p.id) ORDER BY p.nom, p.prenom;

SELECT v.numero_vol, c.nom, a.ville, v.statut FROM vols v JOIN compagnies c ON c.id = v.compagnie_id JOIN aeroports a ON a.id = v.aeroport_arrivee_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id WHERE r.id IS NULL ORDER BY v.date_depart, v.numero_vol;

SELECT p.prenom, p.nom, SUM(r.prix) AS total_depense FROM passagers p JOIN reservations r ON r.passager_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.prenom, p.nom HAVING SUM(r.prix) > 500 ORDER BY total_depense DESC, p.nom;

SELECT v.numero_vol, av.capacite, COUNT(r.id) AS nb_reservations, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacite, 1) AS taux_pct FROM vols v JOIN avions av ON av.id = v.avion_id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.vol_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.numero_vol, av.capacite HAVING 100.0 * COUNT(r.id) / av.capacite > 3 ORDER BY taux_pct DESC;

CREATE TABLE passagers (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    nationalite    VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    date_naissance DATE         NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE compagnies (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom   VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    pays  VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    code  VARCHAR(3)  NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE avions (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    modele         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    immatriculation VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    capacite       INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    compagnie_id   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (compagnie_id) REFERENCES compagnies(id)
);

CREATE TABLE aeroports (
    id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom   VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    ville VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    pays  VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    code  VARCHAR(3)   NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE vols (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    numero_vol          VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    compagnie_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    avion_id            INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    aeroport_depart_id  INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    aeroport_arrivee_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_depart         DATE        NOT NULL,
    heure_depart        TIME        NOT NULL,
    heure_arrivee       TIME        NOT NULL,
    statut              VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (compagnie_id)        REFERENCES compagnies(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (avion_id)            REFERENCES avions(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aeroport_depart_id)  REFERENCES aeroports(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (aeroport_arrivee_id) REFERENCES aeroports(id)
);

CREATE TABLE reservations (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    passager_id      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    vol_id           INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    classe           VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    siege            VARCHAR(5)   NOT NULL,
    prix             NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    date_reservation DATE         NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (passager_id) REFERENCES passagers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (vol_id)      REFERENCES vols(id)
);

CREATE TABLE bagages (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reservation_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    poids_kg       NUMERIC(5,2),
    statut         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE services (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom           VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    etage         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    capacite_lits INTEGER     NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE medecins (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialite    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL,
    service_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id)
);

CREATE TABLE infirmiers (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    service_id    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id)
);

CREATE TABLE patients (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_naissance DATE        NOT NULL,
    sexe           VARCHAR(1)  NOT NULL, -- 'M' ou 'F'
    ville          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_admission DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE consultations (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    medecin_id        INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_consultation DATE        NOT NULL,
    duree_min         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    diagnostic        VARCHAR(100),      -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (medecin_id) REFERENCES medecins(id)
);

CREATE TABLE hospitalisations (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    service_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    medecin_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut  DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin    DATE,                   -- NULL = hospitalisation en cours
    lit         VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (medecin_id) REFERENCES medecins(id)
);

CREATE TABLE prescriptions (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    consultation_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    medicament      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    dosage          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    duree_jours     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (consultation_id) REFERENCES consultations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
    id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom  VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(150)
);

CREATE TABLE plats (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom          VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    categorie_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix         NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    disponible   BOOLEAN      NOT NULL, -- 1 = oui, 0 = non
    FOREIGN KEY (categorie_id) REFERENCES categories(id)
);

CREATE TABLE ingredients (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    unite     VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- kg, L, pièce
    stock     NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    seuil_alerte NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE plats_ingredients (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    plat_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    ingredient_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantite      NUMERIC(6,3) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (plat_id) REFERENCES plats(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients(id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email       VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    telephone   VARCHAR(20),
    date_inscription DATE NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE serveurs (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom       VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE       NOT NULL,
    salaire      NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tables_resto (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    numero      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    nb_places   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    emplacement VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL -- Salle, Terrasse, Bar
);

CREATE TABLE commandes (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id      INTEGER,           -- nullable : commande sans compte client
    serveur_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    table_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_commande  DATE    NOT NULL,
    heure_commande TIME    NOT NULL,
    nb_personnes   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    statut         VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- En cours, Servie, Payée, Annulée
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (serveur_id) REFERENCES serveurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (table_id)   REFERENCES tables_resto(id)
);

CREATE TABLE lignes_commande (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commande_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    plat_id        INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    quantite       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix_unitaire  NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (plat_id)     REFERENCES plats(id)
);

CREATE TABLE avis (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    commande_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    note         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire  VARCHAR(255), -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)   REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (commande_id) REFERENCES commandes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE especes (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom_scientifique VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    nom_commun    VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    classe        VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL, -- Mammifère, Oiseau, Reptile, etc.
    regime        VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Carnivore, Herbivore, Omnivore
    statut_conservation VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL -- LC, NT, VU, EN, CR
);

CREATE TABLE enclos (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom        VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    type       VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Savane, Jungle, Aquatique, Volière, etc.
    surface_m2 INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    capacite   INTEGER     NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE animaux (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    espece_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    enclos_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_naissance DATE       NOT NULL,
    sexe          VARCHAR(1)  NOT NULL, -- M ou F
    poids_kg      NUMERIC(6,2),          -- nullable (pas encore pesé)
    date_arrivee  DATE        NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (espece_id) REFERENCES especes(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (enclos_id) REFERENCES enclos(id)
);

CREATE TABLE soigneurs (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    specialite    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE affectations_soigneurs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    soigneur_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    enclos_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut  DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin    DATE,                  -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (soigneur_id) REFERENCES soigneurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (enclos_id)   REFERENCES enclos(id)
);

CREATE TABLE repas (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    animal_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    soigneur_id INTEGER,               -- nullable : repas automatique
    date_repas  DATE    NOT NULL,
    heure_repas TIME    NOT NULL,
    type_repas  VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,  -- Matin, Midi, Soir
    quantite_kg NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (animal_id)   REFERENCES animaux(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (soigneur_id) REFERENCES soigneurs(id)
);

CREATE TABLE visiteurs (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    ville          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_inscription DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE billets (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    visiteur_id   INTEGER,             -- nullable : billet anonyme
    date_visite   DATE    NOT NULL,
    type_billet   VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Adulte, Enfant, Étudiant, Senior, Famille
    prix          NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (visiteur_id) REFERENCES visiteurs(id)
);

CREATE TABLE avis (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    visiteur_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_avis   DATE    NOT NULL,
    note        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire VARCHAR(255),          -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (visiteur_id) REFERENCES visiteurs(id)
);

bases.fromagerie:
CREATE TABLE producteurs (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    region    VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    pays      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_creation DATE    NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE laits (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    type      VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Vache, Chèvre, Brebis, Bufflonne
    origine   VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL  -- Fermier, Industriel
);

CREATE TABLE fromages (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom           VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    producteur_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    lait_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    type_pate     VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Pâte dure, Pâte molle, Pâte persillée, etc.
    prix_kg       NUMERIC(7,2) NOT NULL,
    disponible    BOOLEAN      NOT NULL, -- 1 = oui, 0 = non
    FOREIGN KEY (producteur_id) REFERENCES producteurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lait_id)       REFERENCES laits(id)
);

CREATE TABLE affinages (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    fromage_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duree_jours   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    temperature_c NUMERIC(4,1) NOT NULL,
    humidite_pct  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut    DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin      DATE,                  -- NULL = affinage en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (fromage_id) REFERENCES fromages(id)
);

CREATE TABLE lots (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    fromage_id  INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    affinage_id INTEGER,                -- nullable : lot non encore affiné
    poids_kg    NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    date_production DATE     NOT NULL,
    numero_lot  VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (fromage_id)  REFERENCES fromages(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (affinage_id) REFERENCES affinages(id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email      VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    ville      VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_inscription DATE  NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE ventes (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id    INTEGER,              -- nullable : vente au comptoir sans compte
    lot_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    date_vente   DATE         NOT NULL,
    quantite_kg  NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    prix_total   NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (lot_id)    REFERENCES lots(id)
);

CREATE TABLE degustations (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fromage_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_degustation DATE NOT NULL,
    note        INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire VARCHAR(255),         -- nullable
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (fromage_id) REFERENCES fromages(id)
);

CREATE TABLE equipes (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom         VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    domaine     VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Biologie, Chimie, Physique, Informatique, etc.
    date_creation DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE chercheurs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    grade       VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, -- Doctorant, Post-doc, Chargé de recherche, Directeur
    equipe_id   INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE      NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (equipe_id) REFERENCES equipes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE projets (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    titre         VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    equipe_id     INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    budget        NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    date_debut    DATE         NOT NULL,
    date_fin      DATE,                   -- NULL = projet en cours
    statut        VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,  -- En cours, Terminé, Suspendu
    FOREIGN KEY (equipe_id) REFERENCES equipes(id)
);

CREATE TABLE experiences (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    projet_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    chercheur_id  INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_experience DATE      NOT NULL,
    duree_heures  NUMERIC(5,1) NOT NULL,
    statut        VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,   -- Planifiée, En cours, Terminée, Échouée
    FOREIGN KEY (projet_id)    REFERENCES projets(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (chercheur_id) REFERENCES chercheurs(id)
);

CREATE TABLE echantillons (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    experience_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    code_echantillon VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    type_echantillon VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, -- Sang, Eau, Roche, Cellules, etc.
    quantite_mg   NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    date_prelevement DATE     NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (experience_id) REFERENCES experiences(id)
);

CREATE TABLE resultats (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    experience_id INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    mesure        VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    valeur        NUMERIC(10,4),          -- nullable : résultat non encore obtenu
    unite         VARCHAR(20),
    date_resultat DATE,                   -- nullable
    valide        BOOLEAN,                -- 1 = validé ; NULL = en attente de validation
    FOREIGN KEY (experience_id) REFERENCES experiences(id)
);

CREATE TABLE publications (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    projet_id     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    titre         VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    revue         VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    date_publication DATE,                -- nullable : en préparation
    doi           VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE,
    FOREIGN KEY (projet_id) REFERENCES projets(id)
);

CREATE TABLE affectations_chercheurs (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    chercheur_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    projet_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    role          VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_debut    DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin      DATE,                   -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (chercheur_id) REFERENCES chercheurs(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (projet_id)    REFERENCES projets(id)
);

CREATE TABLE destinations (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom       VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    pays      VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    continent VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    climat    VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL  -- Tropical, Tempéré, Aride, Polaire
);

CREATE TABLE guides (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom           VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    langue        VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    date_embauche DATE        NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE circuits (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    nom            VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    destination_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    duree_jours    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    prix_base      NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    niveau         VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Facile, Modéré, Sportif
    FOREIGN KEY (destination_id) REFERENCES destinations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE clients (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    prenom         VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    nom            VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email          VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE,
    ville          VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    date_inscription DATE      NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE reservations (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id       INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    circuit_id      INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    date_reservation DATE        NOT NULL,
    nb_personnes    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    statut          VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Confirmée, En attente, Annulée
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (circuit_id) REFERENCES circuits(id)
);

CREATE TABLE paiements (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    reservation_id INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    montant        NUMERIC(9,2) NOT NULL,
    date_paiement  DATE         NOT NULL,
    moyen          VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL, -- Carte, Virement, Espèces, Chèque
    statut         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL, -- Payé, En attente, Remboursé
    FOREIGN KEY (reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE affectations_guides (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    guide_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    circuit_id  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    date_debut  DATE    NOT NULL,
    date_fin    DATE,                  -- NULL = affectation en cours
    FOREIGN KEY (guide_id)   REFERENCES guides(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (circuit_id) REFERENCES circuits(id)
);

CREATE TABLE avis (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    circuit_id     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    note           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (note BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    commentaire    VARCHAR(255),       -- nullable
    date_avis      DATE    NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (client_id)  REFERENCES clients(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (circuit_id) REFERENCES circuits(id)
);

/* Schema pedagogique : clients, produits, commandes, et fidelite
   (une fiche de points par client : relation 1-1, lecon relations 1-1, 1-N et N-N). */
CREATE TABLE clients (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  prenom TEXT NOT NULL,
  nom TEXT,
  adresse TEXT,
  ville TEXT,
  age INTEGER CHECK (age >= 0),
  email TEXT UNIQUE,
  telephone TEXT,
  date_inscription TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE produits (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  nom TEXT NOT NULL,
  categorie TEXT,
  prix REAL,
  stock INTEGER CHECK (stock >= 0)
);
CREATE TABLE commandes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  numero_commande TEXT,
  client_id INTEGER,
  produit_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quantite INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantite > 0),
  date_commande TEXT,
  statut TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_preparation',
  FOREIGN KEY (client_id)
    REFERENCES clients(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (produit_id)
    REFERENCES produits(id)
);
